item.title: Version 3.2.0
item.description: 3.2.0: the shoot checklist (card + six steps after Analyse), Analyse starts at once and switches to AI Cull, the client's target count, guided Shoot Read on Apple on-device, honest Caption counts, Cut exports at each clip's start timecode, Start again, and export the cut, your marks or both.

item.title: Version 3.1.0
item.description: 3.1.0 — one grid, and nothing runs until you press its button. Browse is now the only grid: the Select tab folded into it, and picks, stars and labels live in your files (a shoot culled before 3.0 has its cull written into its files the first time you open it). Each folder opens in Manual Cull or AI Cull, your choice per folder; opening a folder or switching never starts work. Analysis starts from Analyse… (all or selected photos), and Caption, Read the shoot and Judge each run from the new AI menu on the photos you pick. Judge now needs a brief. Shoot details can be typed before a folder is analysed. The AI Cull agreement view compares your keeps with what the AI would pick. With Group bursts on, bursts show as Bands or Stacks (Space opens a stack). Sync Metadata no longer writes AI star ratings unless you tick the box.

item.title: Version 2.10.0
item.description: 2.10.0 — The Cut: build a timeline from your clips on the Edit tab. Analyse the footage, pick a treatment, cut, export FCPXML. Any AI route, local models included; the shoot's photo selects can join the cut.

item.title: Version 2.9.0
item.description: 2.9.0 — Browse · Select · Judge · Edit: the tabs are now the stages of your shoot. Selecting moves to its own tab, Results lives inside Judge, and Edit is ready for the Cut. Processed folders open in Browse as files with an Open in Select button; on a second display the Viewer now follows the raw browse selection while you're in Judge.

item.title: Version 2.8.0
item.description: 2.8.0 — the Shoot Read: after processing, Studio describes a sample of frames and proposes what the shoot is plus two or three angles (Use / Edit / Skip — your words always win). Also new: the Next rail in Browse, and the Selects engine folded in under the hood.

item.title: Version 2.7.2
item.description: Critical fix: builds now launch correctly on Macs other than the development machine (shipped resource bundle). Also carries the correct display font and brand imagery on every machine.

item.title: Version 2.7.1
item.description: Caption Selects: caption just your selects from the workspace toolbar — priced up front, one click. Export fixes: JPG exports now keep your EXIF, GPS, and capture times; the export sheet remembers your last mode and the button says exactly what it will do (no more silent re-encodes when you wanted copies).

item.title: Version 2.7.0
item.description: Auto-updates arrive: the app now updates itself. Also in 2.7.0: Copy Keepers and drag-to-sidebar (the post-cull handoff), typed + voice reasoning notes with visible buttons, the three-tier Judge (The Eye, Brief Interpreter, Roast Slider), revision-aware visual clustering, correct date buckets in Sort into Folders, bundled exiftool, and the new app icon.
